meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在每次编辑代码后会收到评论检查器的自动反馈。若检查出警告，Claude 必须先修复或解释有问题的注释，然后才能继续工作。
howto.when: 在每次成功的 apply_patch、write、edit、multi_edit 或 multiedit 调用之后触发。

say.text: 检查刚才编辑的代码注释是否有警告。
say.note: 触发评论检查器输出反馈。

say.text: 修复注释检查器报告的警告。
say.note: Claude 会处理警告并解释原因。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude receives automatic feedback from a comment checker after every code edit. If a warning is reported, Claude must fix or explain the flagged comment before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered after every successful apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit call.

say_en.text: Check the comments I just edited for warnings.
Fix the warning reported by the comment checker.
